title: RegenScore
tagline: Calculate and show off your on-chain regen activities with your personal RegenScore NFT!
description: "Regen": Short for “regenerative”. A meme-ified term created in response to the mainstream “degen” culture in web3. Refers to the people/culture of using blockchain technology for social/environmental good. "Score": well.. you get it. When you connect your wallet to RegenScore it scans the activity of your address to see, calculate and score your on-chain regen activities; and if you're regen enough, you might even get placed on the leaderboard! In the current MVP (season 1) RegenScore will take a peek at the connected users' interactions on a limited set of protocols and their NFT/token holdings that the RegenScore team deemed to be "regen" enough for a PoC. However, in the future RegenScore will be letting community members/supporters suggest and implement other/new queries the dApp can use to fetch data for a more comprehensive RegenScore calculation. The current list of protocols/NFT/token holdings we are scoring on include: Gitcoin Grants Round contributors (1-14), Giveth donors/$GIV holders, Panvala /$PAN holders, $KLIMA holders, $sKlima holders, $GTC holders, interactions with the Greatest LARP (coordination game for funding public goods), ETHbot, Moloch, MoonshotBots, Rainbow Rolls, World of Women and Pooly NFT contracts (NFT projects donating raised funds to regen causes), donators to the Unchain Fund (Ukraine support), Toucan BCT & NCT contract interactions (carbon offsetting), Proof of Humanity contract interaction + $UBI holders, a couple of regen POAPs (incl. ETHGlobal hackathon POAP holders!), and also query if the address has participated in governance through snapshot votes in a list of "ImpactDAO's" (ImpactDAOs are any web3 project that is using crypto to create positive externalities for the world). After the user has calculated his or her RegenScore they will be able to mint their personal, soulbound NFT with their RegenScore and ENS/address added visually on the actual SVG file to own and show off to frens. The RegenScore NFTs have 4 different backgrounds based on how regen the user's activity is. The usecase for this tokenization of user's RegenScores we hope will be early entrance to regen communities and whitelists to participate in governance of said projects and ecosystems that want to include RegenScore as a tool for sourcing reputable people into their ecosystem. In the next season, in addition to adding more protocols, contracts and on-chain activities to score by; we will implement CTAs for how to improve your regen score.
how_its_made: We use various ways of sourcing the underlying data, most notably Tatum, EtherScan APIs, GraphQL and Snapshot API. We process the data and first display it to the user on a simple frontend built with Next.js, Chakra-UI, wagmi.js and Rainbowkit. If the user chooses to mint their RegenScore NFT, a backend lambda function takes care of creating the dynamic svg and minting it to the user's wallet (we are covering the fees for the time being. In the future, this would be a signed meta-transaction to both remain tamper-proof but avoid spam by offloading the gas fees to the user). The contracts are based on OpenZeppelin ERC721, with the added onlyOwner modifier on the _beforeTokenTransfer function, making the NFTs soulbound (cannot be user-transferred) while retaining the ability for the deployer to move them in case of an emergency (user wallet compromised).  We are using Privy to give users the ability to publish their score on our public leaderboard. Privy makes this super easy, removing the need to manage a database and a REST API. We deployed the contracts to Polygon because of its low cost and great developer experience, and also Optimism for both the above reasons AND because we love the team and community! Users can find us on the regenscore.eth.link and regenscore.eth.limo URLs, and our main contract is deployed at regenscore.eth.
